source.implementation: independent native-width FP32 vector reference, one key-head group

hypothesis: Offset the aligned FP32 projection/readout accumulator by one word to separate SRAM banks from aligned state rows. Preload dedicated DSR bank2: persistent row addresses advance automatically, accumulator/delta addresses reset. Remove per-K descriptor reload/increment while preserving every ascending-K FMA.
falsification: Reject any changed normalization/exp/FMA ordering, skipped K/V term/group/token/history, descriptor overrun or bank side effect, fixed numerical/state/precision/timing failure, shutdown failure, speedup below1.05x or memory above1.10x. Full six-case matched and fresh pairs required; PR1 GQA gains do not establish recurrent gains.
author: unknown
scope: Current experiment targets the fixed one-group native T4 profile only. Source compatibility is not T8 or full-head execution proof. New matched evaluator baselines and fresh six-case pairs required.
